content:
alex: heads-up: users reporting console slowdown when opening SLO list. looks like notify payloads are the culprit (large route matrices + full rule AST).
tara: saw this in user telemetry too. top offenders are multi-tenant rules with long tag maps. client parses a 120kb blob per alert.
ben: quick mitigation idea: send a 'preview' envelope that only contains display fields + routing hints. full payload fetched lazily on expand.
sam: agree. for routing decisions we sometimes need a tiny bit of the matrix though (escalation tier id). preview should include minimal route keys not the whole matrix.
katie: QA note: if we lazy-load, need a smooth UX so expanding an alert doesn't cause layout shift or spinner spam. preload on hover maybe?
alex: hover preload is cool but we must watch traffic costs. preview should be mandatory small. add a header hint for client: `Prefer-Preview: true`.
tara: also want a compact noise estimate so the minimap shows noisy vs not without loading details. fields: noise_score, sample_rate, est_sample_count.
ben: implementation options: 1) transform at notify-service (creates preview object), 2) produce preview upstream at ingest to avoid per-request compute. upstream is better for scale.
sam: ingest team: can we add a lightweight preview to the write stream? it's just a mapped projection of existing fields.
ci-bot: ci-bot: ingest-producer pipeline #438 started build.
katie: routing policy concern: some downstream ops rely on route metadata for auto-escalation (runbooks). preview must carry an `escalation_hint` enum or boolean.
alex: agreed. include escalation_hint: NONE | AUTO | MANUAL. small enum int is fine.
tara: telemetry/billing: we cannot lose token estimates. preview must include `tokens_est` and `model_family` to reconcile invoicing.
ben: proto vs JSON debate: binary proto reduces size but breaks debugging and devtools. lean towards compact JSON (minified) initially, add proto later if needed.
sam: OK. compact JSON + gz content-encoding for wire. Also add `x-rw-canary: preview-v1` header for staged rollout.
katie: rollout plan suggestion: 1) preview field written by ingest behind feature flag, 2) notify-service surfaces `?preview=true` endpoint, 3) console opt-in via feature flag, 4) 2-week canary, 5) enable by default if perf goals met.
alex: perf targets: minimap full render <180ms for 10 alerts, client mem <60MB. set automated perf test in staging.
tara: testing: add unit test to ensure preview contains summary_line (human-readable), one-line expression snippet, and escalation_hint.
ben: preview schema sketch (compact JSON):
```
{
 "id":"a1b2c3",
 "tenant":"t-42",
 "summary":"30m p95 > 1%",
 "tokens_est":123,
 "model_family":"gptx",
 "noise_score":0.72,
 "sample_rate":0.1,
 "escalation_hint":2
}
```

sam: regarding kafka: create `notify-previews` topic keyed by alert id for services that want to populate caches. small payloads only.
ci-bot: ci-bot: notify-service PR #891 passed tests and was merged.
katie: UI fallback: if preview missing, still fetch full alert but show a skeleton card. no crash.
alex: docs: add API note about `Prefer-Preview` header, `?preview=true`, and canary header. also update observability to track preview-miss ratio.
tara: last edge case: tenant-level encryption: previews must not include PII or blobs. scrub the tenant meta.
ben: ack, preview generator will drop `tenant_blob` and any freeform tags > 256 chars.
sam: pairing tomorrow between ingest + notify teams to wire the preview field. alex + katie will own console changes.
alex: great. we'll reconvene after a staging perf run. :rocket:
